## Time Series Analysis and Forecasting

Eight-week accelerated session — asynchronous online.
Department of Economics, Strome College of Business, Old Dominion University.

This site holds the lecture slides and week-by-week plan for the course.
All graded work, submissions, and grades are handled in **Canvas**.

- [Course Information](about.qmd) — objectives, texts, grading, and policies
- [Meet Your Instructor](sitti.qmd)

|:--:|:---------------|:--------|:----|
| 1 | [Visuals, Data, and the Forecasting Workflow](week-1.qmd) | Diebold Ch. 1–2; FPP3 Ch. 2 | HW 1 |

## A Note on Pace

This section covers the same material as the sixteen-week course in half the time.
Plan on roughly **15–18 hours per week**. Modules stay open after their due dates so
you can work ahead, but falling a week behind is very difficult to recover from.

## Software

You will need **R** and **RStudio**, both free:

- R — <https://www.r-project.org/>
- RStudio — <https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/>
- Posit Cloud (browser-based alternative) — <https://posit.cloud/>
